evidence: synthetic only; ordinary robust POMDP is not a novelty claim
other_parameters: v1 defaults, equally known to all model-based policies
robust_candidate: 4-step rectangular max-of-model conditional expected losses, with history-conditioned per-model Bayes beliefs and action risk gates; conservative heuristic for a fixed unknown model, not exact nonrectangular minimax
model_weights: equal prior Bayes model weights recorded diagnostically, not used to discard models or relax worst-case gate
dev_selection: pool equal-weight nominal+long; loss=cost+40*false_completion+80*duplicate+8*abstention; pick minimum loss; additionally min-cost rule with success >= robust_dev_success-.01, duplicate <= robust_dev_duplicate+.01, false_completion <= robust_dev_false_completion+.01; unavailable if none
test_selection: none; outside delays never used for development

seed_formulas.dev: seed*1000000 + i (same initial draws across dev model regimes)

uncertainty: paired seed normal descriptive intervals; no rare-risk certification; shared condition seeds not independent across conditions
stop: no new algorithm claim; stop before real-agent expansion if simple matched-quality rule explains gains, robustness mostly abstention, or outside-set failures; no test-informed retuning
amendment_before_reading_test_results: Add single-nominal-model planner with exactly same lookahead, conditional risk gates and retry budget as model-set planner; all prior outputs retained uninspected under pre-ablation-uninspected. No outcomes or test values read. All methods/grid/seed remain unchanged.
